mapper.select: SELECT ac.id, ac.user_id, ac.activity_id, ac.to_comment_id, ac.content, ac.create_time, ac.root_id, IFNULL(ach.comment_hot, 0) AS comment_hot FROM activity_comment ac LEFT JOIN activity_comment_hot ach ON ac.id = ach.comment_id WHERE ac.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ac.root_id IS NULL ORDER BY ac.create_time DESC

SELECT ac.id, ac.user_id, ac.activity_id, ac.to_comment_id, ac.content, ac.create_time, ac.root_id, IFNULL(ach.comment_hot, 0) AS comment_hot FROM activity_comment ac LEFT JOIN activity_comment_hot ach ON ac.id = ach.comment_id WHERE ac.root_id = #{rootId} AND ac.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ac.create_time ASC
